# A comment above the right-hand operand of a binary operator stays above
# it. It used to be moved after the operator, and was lost when the result
# was formatted again.
celfmt -i add.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout add.cel

# With parentheses the comment is inside them.
celfmt -i paren.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_paren.txt

celfmt -i want_paren.txt
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_paren.txt

-- add.cel --
state.a +
// c
state.b
-- paren.cel --
state.a *
// c
(state.b + state.c)
-- want_paren.txt --
state.a * (
	// c
	state.b + state.c
)
